data.body:
[P2] Widen existing Aurora columns during stack updates

Both custom-resource lifecycle handlers execute `createTableSql`, which remains `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`. Redeploying an existing stack therefore succeeds while leaving `execution_arn` at 256 characters and `execution_name` at 128; exports with longer identifiers continue failing despite this fix. Add an idempotent `ALTER TABLE ... ALTER COLUMN ... TYPE ...` migration for existing tables and cover the upgrade from the old schema in tests.
